cases.purpose: Numeric tokens must not rewrite keys, quoted lookalikes, escaped Unicode or embedded BOM strings.
Observe case and sign variants as a sequence, without assuming JSON grammar.
NaN payload spelling is an oracle question, not a presumed rejection.
Signaling NaN spelling is an oracle question.
Incomplete special token must not consume a later valid record.
Bad special-number suffix, valid following scalar, every byte cut.
Observe leading zero, signed zero, absent integer/fraction digits, plus and exponent neighbors.
Hex-looking prefix followed by a valid JSON record.
Retain completed output but stop after a malformed exponent.
Do not globally remove or reinterpret repeated signs.
Retained decimal precision and overflow lexemes differ from binary arithmetic.
Distinguish parsed NaN, infinities, null and strings; copy through arrays and objects.
Arithmetic must preserve nonfinite semantics rather than only its serialized null/max-double.
Observe self equality and order, plus null/zero comparisons in this native profile.
Keep native ordering including NaN and textual lookalikes; no hand-written numeric expectations.
Rendered null does not itself determine -e truth status.
Last output status after special numeric input.
UTF-8 runtime diagnostic, subsequent false output, final -e status.
Runtime failure is not a parse-fatal stop; subsequent truthy output.
Byte columns after UTF-8 and nested accepted numeric prefix; preserve only complete outputs.
Scalar boundaries adjoining containers and quoted lookalikes without whitespace.
Split every byte of an initial UTF-8 BOM and following nonstandard number.
A second leading BOM is not silently globally stripped.
BOM after a completed scalar is not initial BOM.
Whitespace before BOM distinguishes initial prefix handling.
Malformed BOM prefix with a mismatching third byte across every cut.
Observe parser BOM state across separate file arguments, not assumed per-file reset.
Raw input keeps initial and embedded BOM and all numeric lookalike bytes.
Raw slurp across files preserves each BOM and quoted lookalikes.
File-routed malformed token byte offsets and no later-file output after parse fatal.
Runtime error filename and line plus later-file successful output.
Decimal tokens around 256 and 4096 bytes, without exhaustive chunk Cartesian products.
Actual public Shell pipe loses original nonfinite representation on serialization; assert direct stages too.
Upstream parse-fatal prefix still reaches downstream; last stage status and stderr both matter.
Accepted NaN with no result must retain -e no-output semantics.
